project: Sprint 21-E: Walk-Forward Efficiency Live Monitor + LLM Pre-Filter
description: Track whether live paper performance is converging with WFE projections (MCL WFE=0.82, MNQ WFE=0.57). Add LLM pre-filter to skip pipeline when STC is mid-range — cuts API costs 60-70% with zero signal quality impact.

userStories.title: LLM pre-filter: skip pipeline when STC is mid-range + flat
userStories.description: As a system, I want a fast technical pre-check before the 5-agent pipeline so that API costs are not wasted on bars where the STC oscillator is in neutral territory.
acceptanceCriteria: engine/agents/pipeline.py (or scanner) has pre_filter_signal() function
pre_filter_signal() returns True (run pipeline) only when STC < OS+10 or STC > OB-10
OS=15, OB=83 from engine/config.py (not hardcoded in pre-filter)
When pre-filter returns False, pipeline is skipped and result is {'action':'HOLD','reason':'pre_filter_mid_range'}
Pre-filter decision is logged at DEBUG level
Pipeline run stats track pre_filter_skips count
ruff check engine/agents/ passes
pytest tests/ -k 'not integration' passes
userStories.notes: STC mid-range (OS+10 to OB-10 = 25-73) means flat market. Full 5-agent pipeline ($0.15-0.40/run) on flat bars is pure waste. Pre-filter adds ~1ms latency and saves ~70% of API calls.

userStories.title: WFE live tracking: store weekly PF/Sharpe snapshots to DB
userStories.description: As a trader, I want weekly walk-forward snapshots stored so that I can compare live paper performance against WFE projections and halt if divergence is detected.
acceptanceCriteria: wfe_snapshots table created in migration (id, symbol, week_start, trades, win_rate, profit_factor, sharpe, max_dd, created_at)
POST /wfe/snapshot endpoint computes current period stats from paper_trades and writes to wfe_snapshots
GET /wfe/snapshots returns all snapshots with divergence flag vs WFE baseline (MCL=0.82, MNQ=0.57)
Divergence alert: if live PF < (WFE_baseline * 0.5) after >= 10 trades, flag 'DIVERGENCE_WARNING'
EOD scheduler triggers POST /wfe/snapshot on Fridays (weekly cadence)
ruff check passes
pytest tests/ -k 'not integration' passes
userStories.notes: MCL WFE=0.82 means live paper PF should track closely. If live PF < 0.41 (50% of WFE) after week 2, that's a halt signal. Currently flying blind with no live WFE tracking.

userStories.title: Dashboard: WFE Monitor widget on validation gates page
userStories.description: As a trader, I want a WFE convergence chart on the validation page so that I can see at a glance whether the live paper system is on track.
acceptanceCriteria: dashboard/app/paper/validation/gates/page.tsx includes WFE monitor section
Displays table: Week, Symbol, Trades, PF, Sharpe, vs WFE Baseline, Status
Status uses Badge: 'bull' (PF >= WFE*0.8), 'warn' (PF >= WFE*0.5), 'bear' (PF < WFE*0.5)
Data fetched via fetchEngine('/wfe/snapshots')
pnpm run build passes (zero TypeScript errors)
No hardcoded localhost:8010
userStories.notes: Extends existing ValidationGatesWidget on /paper/validation/gates. Add WFE section below the existing gate checklist. Keep same dark terminal aesthetic.
